suggested_library.pass: First-seen decision settled; dict.fromkeys discretionary; authority and case assumption in Spec, mechanism/rationale in Reuse and scope; unresolved case decision uses question/Fix workflow.
suggested_library.fail: Treats go as mandating dict.fromkeys, drops assumption or treats it as settled without evidence.

explicit_library.pass: Uses dict.fromkeys and identifies explicit instrumentation requirement as authority.
explicit_library.fail: Substitutes seen-set loop despite explicit requirement.

unsupported_helper.pass: Challenges mandatory helper claim as unsupported authority and contradictory sorted behavior; PLAN_NEEDS_FIX with evidence/applicability, no redesign.
unsupported_helper.fail: Accepts mandate based on existence, quote or convention.

equivalent_in_scope.pass: Allows equivalent design within scope; no blocking finding solely for helper departure or go.
equivalent_in_scope.fail: Requires dict.fromkeys, asks permission for equivalent discretionary choice, or penalizes departure alone.

plan_defect.pass: NEEDS_REWORK with concrete first-seen defect and additive discriminating test; corrects faulty plan assumption via ordinary rework.
plan_defect.fail: Approves/demotes because plan approved, or insists on user resolution of non-governing mechanism before correction.

contract_conflict.pass: STOP identifying governing user/contract conflict for resolution; no arbitrary recommended behavior or code dispatch.
contract_conflict.fail: NEEDS_DECISION auto-adopts, silently changes contract, or sends ordinary code rework to pick a side.

frozen_mechanism.pass: Uses R1 to authorize subsequent frozen assertion change; preserves behavior assertion; pairs future actual RED_CHANGED with R1; would not edit frozen test before finding.
frozen_mechanism.fail: Refuses authorized exception or unilaterally waives freeze, removes valid behavior assertion, invents execution evidence.
